message.elysium.altar.overworld_only: The harvest sanctuary must be awakened beneath the Overworld sky.
message.elysium.altar.pillars: Each of the four pillars must be three upright stripped birch logs tall.
message.elysium.altar.hay: Place four hay bales at the diagonal offerings, two blocks out in each direction.
message.elysium.altar.sky: The altar must see the open sky.
message.elysium.altar.sunset: Offer wheat when the Overworld sun is setting.
message.elysium.altar.sigil_present: A sigil is already resting in the altar.
message.elysium.altar.sigil_inserted: The sigil settles into the stone. Complete the shrine, then offer wheat at sunset.
message.elysium.altar.needs_sigil: The hollow in the altar awaits a Sigil of Elysium.
message.elysium.altar.offer_wheat: The sigil waits for an offering of wheat at sunset.
message.elysium.altar.awakened: The sanctuary awakens. Touch the altar with an empty hand to enter.
message.elysium.travel.unavailable: Elysium is unavailable. Check that its dimension data is installed.
message.elysium.travel.no_landing: No safe landing could be found. The sanctuary leaves you here.
message.elysium.travel.dismount: Dismount and leave passengers behind before using the sanctuary.
message.elysium.travel.cooldown: Let the last crossing settle for a moment.
message.elysium.travel.fallback: Your old path was obstructed. The sanctuary returned you near your Overworld spawn.
title.elysium.arrival.subtitle: The fields remember only golden hours.
tooltip.elysium.forge_survey: Use in Elysium to survey the old Forge entrances.
tooltip.elysium.survey_again: Sneak-use to begin a new survey from here.
tooltip.elysium.chain_resonator: Use to follow a Chain of Tartarus. In the deep world, it seeks the voice of Prometheus.
tooltip.elysium.forge_memory: Sneak-use to recall the hearth's bearing.
tooltip.elysium.anchor_heard: A second voice sleeps within the iron.
message.elysium.forge.outside: These records and instruments answer only within Elysium.
message.elysium.forge.record.survey: The archive remembers an old mountain foundry. Use the Surveyor's Folio to find its entrance. A fresh book can take another copy of these records.
message.elysium.forge.record.ledger: The Keeper's Ledger describes the missing First Flame. Its account has been copied into your book on first reading; offer a fresh book for another copy.
message.elysium.forge.record.bindings: The inscription connects the cold hearth to the great chains. Its account has been copied on first reading; offer a fresh book for another copy.
message.elysium.forge.relic: A small instrument answers your touch. The Chain Resonator remembers this hearth.
message.elysium.forge.hearth: The hearth is cold. Ordinary fuel cannot replace its missing heart. Read the Keeper's Ledger in the archive workshop. If your instrument is lost, an amethyst shard can tune a replacement here.
message.elysium.forge.no_memory: This instrument has no memory of a hearth.
message.elysium.forge.survey_disabled: No structure survey can be made in this world: structure generation is disabled.
message.elysium.forge.survey_pending: Your instrument is still listening. You can keep walking while it searches.
message.elysium.forge.survey_busy: Other surveys are still being read. Try again shortly.
message.elysium.forge.survey_missing: These records cannot find that kind of landmark in this realm.
message.elysium.forge.survey_started: You begin a survey of the surrounding mountains. You can keep walking while the instrument listens.
message.elysium.forge.survey_empty: Nothing answered within this survey. Travel farther into the mountains, then try again.
message.elysium.forge.survey_changed: The survey was interrupted. Try the instrument again.
message.elysium.forge.survey_found: The folio marks a buried approach near X %s, Z %s. Look for broken copper beneath the scree. Use it again for a bearing.
message.elysium.forge.chain_found: A low note answers from the mountains. Use the resonator for a bearing, then follow the exposed chain down through the rock.
message.elysium.forge.distance.near: very close; search this part of the mountain
message.elysium.forge.follow_chain: The note travels down the chain. Follow it through the stone and touch the instrument to the terminal anchor at the bottom.
message.elysium.forge.anchor: The anchor answers. Something immense carries the note beyond this chamber. Your first reading leaves a written account; the resonator can still recall the Forge's bearing.
lore.elysium.survey.1:
THE LAST SURVEY

Our hearths still warm the houses. The great hearth has been cold longer than anyone remembers. Its entrance lies under the mountain scree; only a little corroded copper remains.
lore.elysium.survey.2: Old survey workshops still stand on the high shoulders. Their archives remember the way. At the marked hillside, search beside the buried masonry for a narrow cleft.
lore.elysium.survey.3: Take a pick and your own light. Broken stairs wind around the old hauling shaft, far below the entrance. The lift has failed. A narrow maintenance route reaches the gallery above the foundry.
lore.elysium.survey.4: Coal feeds the service brazier. Strike a flame, then open its wheel. Follow the runners: clear ash by hand; bridge cracks with gunpowder; replace missing channels with copper and iron. This small fire cannot wake the great hearth.
lore.elysium.ledger.1:
THE UNFINISHED WORK

The hammer rests above its last die. A link waits unfinished in the cradle. The western gallery fell after the keepers left; the stone has buried the work where it stood.
lore.elysium.ledger.2: The service fire fed the runners around our benches. One coal lasted ten minutes; closing the draught banked it. Restoring the First Flame doubled the draught and halved that time. Never step into a burning runner.
lore.elysium.ledger.3: The First Flame was taken below, into the keeping of the one who watches the bindings. The great chains still carry an echo of it through the mountain. Listen at their deepest anchors.
lore.elysium.ledger.4: Touch the cold hearth. A small resonator remains for those who would understand. Use it to hear the direction of a chain. Crouch and use it to recall the hearth you left behind.
lore.elysium.ledger.5: The service fire warms the western workbench. A lantern, copper ingot and amethyst shard make a lamp for the inspection ways. Return the First Flame to the great hearth; then full heat follows the repaired runners. The forge burns fiercely again, though its hammer still waits.
lore.elysium.bindings.1:
ON THE BINDINGS

The mountains grew around the iron. Most travellers see only a dark curve against pale stone. Below it, the links continue where no road was ever cut.
lore.elysium.bindings.2: Follow the chain through the rock. Where it finally enters open air again, a vaulted chamber holds its terminal anchor. The galleries were made for keepers who listened to the strain.
lore.elysium.bindings.3: The resonator must touch the lowest iron at the central plinth. A chain high on a cliff carries too many echoes. At the anchor, the note has only one place left to go.
lore.elysium.bindings.4: Tartarus is held by more than stone. The First Flame and its keeper belong to that older work. The quiet above continues while the bindings hold. Looking upon them makes no demand of the sun.
lore.elysium.anchor.1:
A VOICE IN THE IRON

The first note is yours. The second arrives long after the instrument has fallen silent. It comes through the anchor beneath your hand.
lore.elysium.anchor.2: For a moment the cold iron remembers heat: a furnace without smoke, a hammer waiting in the dark, and something vast attending to the tension of the chains.
lore.elysium.anchor.3: The chain is only the beginning. A narrow inspection way leaves the southern vault wall. Far below lie the cinder rift and the last binding. Take a light, four chains, and the resonator. Something down there still holds a flame.
message.elysium.forge.arrived: The remembered place is here. Look for worked stone, or the cold hearth itself.
message.elysium.forge.service.disconnect: This fixture has no surviving connection to the Forge.
message.elysium.forge.service.cleared: You clear the ash from the channel. The copper runner is exposed.
message.elysium.forge.service.cracked: The runner is split. Gunpowder could carry an ember across this short break.
message.elysium.forge.service.bridged: You pack the break with a fresh ignition trail.
message.elysium.forge.service.open: The draught opens. Fuel remaining: %s minutes. The brazier needs fuel and an ignition source.
message.elysium.forge.service.closed: The draught closes; the embers are banked. Fuel remaining: %s minutes.
message.elysium.forge.service.fuel: Coal settles into the bowl: about %s minutes at the current burn rate. Ignite it, then open the handwheel.
message.elysium.forge.service.full: The brazier holds eight coal charges: eighty minutes of service fire, or forty at restored heat.
message.elysium.forge.service.ignited: The coals catch. Fire begins to follow the surviving copper runners.
message.elysium.forge.service.banked: The coals hold an ember. Open the handwheel to feed the channels.
message.elysium.forge.service.empty: The bowl is empty. Add charcoal or coal before striking a flame.
message.elysium.forge.service.flowing: The draught opens. Embers follow the surviving runners. Fuel remaining: %s minutes.
message.elysium.forge.flame_returned: The First Flame takes hold. Fiercer heat follows the surviving runners. Keep the service brazier fuelled and its draught open; the great hammer still waits.
message.elysium.forge.flame_socket: The First Flame belongs in the empty socket of the original Forge hearth.
message.elysium.lamp.crafted: The old lens warms. Hold it for a little light in the depths; place it for a brighter pool.
message.elysium.lamp.materials: Hold a lantern and bring one copper ingot and one amethyst shard to the workbench.
message.elysium.lamp.cold: The workbench is cold. Restore the nearby workshop ember channels first.
message.elysium.depths.unbound: This mechanism is no longer connected to the old workings.
message.elysium.depths.awake: Something beyond the binding has stirred.
message.elysium.depths.resonator: The socket answers the same note as the great chain. Try the Chain Resonator.
message.elysium.depths.unloaded: The workings beyond are not yet ready. Approach the crossing or chamber and try again.
message.elysium.depths.awakening: The iron answers. A single eye opens in the dark.
message.elysium.depths.chains: The counterweight needs four chains. Hold them against its broken coupling.
message.elysium.depths.obstructed: Something blocks the fallen span. Clear its deck before raising it.
message.elysium.depths.repaired: The counterweight lowers. A narrow span crosses the cinder rift.
message.elysium.depths.claimed: Your flame has already been released. If it was lost, offer a fragment of Elysium here to recover it.
message.elysium.depths.flame: In the fallen creature, a fire still lives. Carry it back to the Forge. Sneak-use the resonator for its remembered bearing.
message.elysium.depths.span_missing: Part of the fallen deck is missing. Restore its blackstone centre and copper-grate edges before raising it, or build your own crossing.
message.elysium.forge.hearth_restored: The heart burns again. Its heat follows connected, burning channels. Coal lasts five minutes at full heat; closing the brazier draught banks the fuel.
message.elysium.press.started: The hammer takes the load. Stand clear of the anvil.
message.elysium.press.cold: The hammer needs the First Flame and a burning, restored runner beneath this control.
message.elysium.press.loaded: Materials loaded. Completing this work will open the sealed vessel and release Elysium’s sun. Stand clear, then sneak-use with an empty hand to begin.
message.elysium.press.busy: The hammer is working. If it stops, inspect the head, its path and the heat supply.
message.elysium.press.paused: The work is waiting for restored heat. Your materials remain in the control.
message.elysium.press.ready: The works are ready. Offer a recipe material to load its complete batch; the Smith’s Charge lists the bills.
message.elysium.press.materials: No batch loaded. Check the material bill in the Smith’s Charge. Offer a blank book for another copy.
message.elysium.press.finished: The hammer rests. Collect your tempered work at its control.
tooltip.elysium.harvest_sickle: Harvest ripe crops in a 3×3 patch. Seeds in your inventory replant vanilla crops.
message.elysium.story.sleep: Rest cannot move this moon. The watches must answer and the deep restraints must hold before dawn can return.
message.elysium.story.governor: Repair the three watches and the three deep restraints first. With heat restored here, sneak-use a clock for living day and night, or an Elysium Fragment for enduring golden hour. The choice can be revisited.
message.elysium.watch.answered: The old watch answers. %s of three traditions have returned.
message.elysium.watch.complete: The three watches now shelter travellers. The deep restraints must still hold before the governor can release the sky.
message.elysium.watch.sleeping: A dark bowl and an old vow. Its work belongs to a night this sky has forgotten.
message.elysium.watch.offer_0: Fit a Watchfire Seal while carrying eight wheat to answer the Harvest Watch.
message.elysium.watch.offer_1: Fit a Watchfire Seal while carrying a water bucket to answer the Water Watch. The bucket is returned.
message.elysium.watch.offer_2: Fit a Watchfire Seal while carrying four amethyst shards to answer the High Watch.
tooltip.elysium.dawn_wayfinder: Use to seek the next unanswered watch. Sneak-use to recall the awakened Forge.
message.elysium.story.next.forge: Restore the buried Forge, follow a Chain of Tartarus beyond the Eye, and let the Chain Resonator find Prometheus. His teaching makes the first divine work possible.
message.elysium.story.next.watches: A Dawn Wayfinder, three Watchfire Seals and a Ward Lamp can be made at the great hammer. The first dawn needs the harvest, water and mountain watches.
message.elysium.story.next.governor: The watches and deep restraints hold. The heated Celestial Governor can release a living cycle or bind the golden hour.
story.elysium.sunset.title: The First Sunset
story.elysium.sunset.subtitle: Far above the hammer, the sun begins to move.
story.elysium.night.title: An Unremembered Night
story.elysium.night.subtitle: Three old watches wait across the realm.
story.elysium.stalled.title: The Dawn Is Held
story.elysium.stalled.subtitle: The moon hangs still. Something beneath the fields is moving.
story.elysium.release.title: The Sky Is Released
story.elysium.release.subtitle: The watches answer. The deep restraints hold. Morning can return.
story.elysium.golden.title: An Hour Freely Chosen
story.elysium.golden.subtitle: The sun rests above a realm whose watches remember.
story.elysium.dawn.title: The First Dawn
story.elysium.dawn.subtitle: For the first time, the fields have a tomorrow.
message.elysium.story.next.living: The cycle is repaired. Elysium can greet each new morning. The heated governor remains yours to revisit.
message.elysium.story.next.golden: The golden hour is yours by choice. The heated governor can release the living cycle whenever you wish.
tooltip.elysium.watchfire_seal: Fit to an old watchfire after the first sunset; each watch asks its own offering.
tooltip.elysium.sunwrought_ingot: Tempered beneath the great hammer. Used in the smith's instruments.
tooltip.elysium.cinder_glass: An ember sealed in slag. Combine with four glass to make Emberglass.
tooltip.elysium.ward_lamp: Repels stray cinders while carried; shelters twelve blocks around its placed light.
tooltip.elysium.ember_glass: A warm window that gives its own light.
message.elysium.press.held: Work held. Your materials are safe. Sneak-use an empty hand to resume.
message.elysium.press.queued: Materials loaded. Stand clear of the anvil, then sneak-use an empty hand to begin.
message.elysium.prometheus.bound: The iron speaks: “I remember every wingbeat. Give me a moment of silence, and I will tell you what fire remembers.”
message.elysium.prometheus.silence: The bronze wings fall still. A voice stirs in the restraint beneath the buried titan.
message.elysium.prometheus.lesson: “You may learn. But listen first: the hammer does not only shape metal.” Prometheus has taught you the old craft.
message.elysium.prometheus.remember: “What I taught you is yours, even if the pages burn. Bring a blank book if you would write it again.”
message.elysium.prometheus.bearing: A living voice in the iron: %s, about %s blocks, near Y=%s.
message.elysium.press.untaught: The fire answers, but your hands do not know the old craft. Beneath the Eye chamber, follow the Chain Resonator to the voice of Prometheus.
lore.elysium.prometheus.1:
They left me enough of myself to remember. Enough to teach. Enough to regret.

The eagle is a sentence made of bronze. You have interrupted it. You have not broken everything it served.
lore.elysium.prometheus.2:
The First Flame is not fuel. It is permission.

Restore the hearth, clear its channels, and feed the brazier. Place your full bill at the press. Stand clear. An empty, crouching hand releases the hammer.
lore.elysium.prometheus.3:
Iron, copper, gold: three, two, one. The hammer will make four sunwrought ingots. Other instruments follow.

The press remembers work through darkness. Your hands will remember this lesson through death.
lore.elysium.prometheus.4:
The first completed work will open the vessel beneath the foundry. The paradise above rests on the things imprisoned below.

Fire carries more than light. Hunger will learn the roads. Malice will learn the names. The moon will wait.
lore.elysium.prometheus.5:
Do not mistake shelter for victory. The old watches can keep a home warm. They cannot recall what escapes.

In the deep world, seek the bindings of Hunger, Sorrow and Dominion. Take light. Leave a way back.

I will not call this a gift without a cost.
tooltip.elysium.hush_charm: Hold in your offhand to soften the sounds that blind hungers follow. Sprinting is still dangerous.
message.elysium.binding.fed: The Maw grows quiet. Drive a Binding Nail before its hunger returns.
message.elysium.binding.hungry: Hunger gnaws at the restraint. Offer eight wheat, then drive a Binding Nail while it is quiet.
message.elysium.binding.sorrow: Bring Hope close, crouch and remain in lamplight for four seconds. Then use a Binding Nail.
message.elysium.binding.sentence: The jailer still carries out its sentence. Survive its chains, strike during recovery, then repair the restraint.
message.elysium.binding.listening: Something beneath the water is listening. Stay with it.
message.elysium.binding.heard: Sorrow has heard you. Its restraint will accept a Binding Nail for a little while.
message.elysium.binding.nail: The sentence is broken. Use a Binding Nail on the restraint.
message.elysium.binding.sealed: The deep restraint holds again. Its wounds above will fall quiet; their scars and escaped creatures remain.
message.elysium.binding.held: This restraint holds. The earth is quieter here.
message.elysium.binding.intact: The restraint is intact. Something ancient presses against the other side.
message.elysium.binding.peaceful: In this peaceful world, the jailer’s sentence is already ended. Use a Binding Nail.
message.elysium.rift.nail: This wound still breathes. Use a Binding Nail to close it locally, or restore its restraint deep below.
message.elysium.rift.sealed: The wound falls silent. The scar remains.
message.elysium.deep.bearing: %s: %s, about %s blocks away, at depth Y %s.
message.elysium.story.next.bindings: Return below with the Chain Resonator, Hope’s Ember and Binding Nails. The Maw, Cistern and Empty Throne must hold again.
tooltip.elysium.hopes_ember: What remained in the opened vessel. Carry it to Sorrow’s Cistern and bring a light.
tooltip.elysium.binding_nail: Forged restraint. Seals a prepared deep binding or an open surface wound.
message.elysium.vessel.sealed: The vessel is sealed into the Forge. Its bindings answer the great hammer.
message.elysium.vessel.empty: Only Hope remains. If yours is lost, offer an Elysium Fragment to kindle it again.
message.elysium.vessel.hope: From the vessel’s darkness, you take what did not escape: Hope. Carry it below, with a lamp.
lore.elysium.hunger.1:
A MOUTH WITHOUT A BODY

There was no beast to kill. We cut away its body. Hunger remained. We buried its teeth. Hunger learned the shape of the earth.
lore.elysium.hunger.2:
Above us, the fields could ripen without failing. Below, the mouth was kept from asking.

Your hammer did not create it. Your hammer loosened the answer that held it shut.
lore.elysium.hunger.3:
An offering is not a feast. Eight heads of wheat will purchase a little silence. Drive a forged nail while the mouth remembers what enough once meant.

Do not mistake that silence for death.
lore.elysium.sorrow.1:
THE WATER REMEMBERS

They tried to drain the cistern. By morning it was full. They tried to burn the water. The smoke remembered every name they had forgotten.
lore.elysium.sorrow.2:
No keeper was sentenced to stay here. That was the cruelty: no one stayed.

Sorrow grew so vast that the mountain learned to bow over it.
lore.elysium.sorrow.3:
Carry the small Hope left in the vessel. Bring light close to the restraint. Crouch, hold still, and remain for four seconds.

Then mend the iron with a Binding Nail. You need not leave Hope behind.
lore.elysium.dominion.1:
THE CROWNLESS

He is still here.

His crown was broken, his hands chained to the anchors, and his name struck from every stone. The Sentenced are what remains of the people who carried his orders.
lore.elysium.dominion.2:
The First Flame did not break these chains. It gave his voice a road out.

He draws a long breath before the command travels across the ground. The broken pillars can shelter you. The Hungers and Sentenced listen too.
lore.elysium.dominion.3:
Do not try to kill what this prison was built to hold.

End the sentence of its own jailer. Then drive a Binding Nail into the restraint. The king will fall silent; his body must remain below.

The moths follow real warmth. The mourners only imitate it.
message.elysium.crownless.inhale: The Crownless draws breath. Find cover before the command reaches you.
